Raga: Multani
Tala: Vilambit Ektal/ Drut Teental
Vocal: E Gokul Gam Ko ChoraA Jhanak Jhanak Mori Payal Baaje
A soulful Hindustani classical vocal rendition by Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan, featuring “E Gokul Gam Ko Chora... A Jhanak Jhanak Mori Payal Baaje”. The performance highlights the melodic character of the raga and the artist’s expressive voice and mastery of Hindustani classical music.
